title: KIS Outfitters: Guided Hunting and Fishing
gap: Prices for all offerings not stated
blurb: KIS Outfitters offers guided hunting and fishing trips in Utah, including full-day fishing on a chartered boat and multi-day guided hunts for elk and deer with lodging. They provide application assistance for Utah draw system tags and offer options for public land and private ranch hunts. Lodging options include tents, travel trailers, and pods with Starlink when available.
